header.description: Codex round-4 findings 4-8 (theming/nested slice): createTheme at-rule collation on the hash path, defineVars keyed-object rule accumulation, nested CSSType brand containment, nested __proto__ [[Set]] drops, and callable conditional-leaf String coercion. Oracle is @stylexjs/babel-plugin 0.19.0 run live; r4-collation-unverified-hard-error is a documented rust-rejects-more divergence (expect ok upstream, loud UnsupportedApi in rust) and is excluded here because the differ has no divergence-pin lane — it is pinned in tests/theming.rs instead.
